name: A Last Request

faq.answer: The fallen peacekeeper's exact identity remains unstated in the initial discovery. What is evident is his role as a keeper of order whose duty ended violently, leaving behind only the urgent message clutched in his grip.

The bloody note is the peacekeeper's last account. The cult struck his post by surprise: Raani never saw it coming, Arvensus took a sword to the gut, and he himself was felled by a lightning bolt and left for dead, expecting his wounds to finish what the cult began.
faq.q: What is written on the bloody note?

aliases: how to start a last request
where is a last request found
faq.answer: This task begins directly upon discovering and examining the lifeless body of a peacekeeper. Searching the fallen defender reveals the bloody note clutched in his lifeless hands, outlining his final plea.

The cult ambushed his post without warning. His fellow peacekeepers fell, and he was struck by a lightning bolt and left for dead. He lived just long enough to set down what happened in the note found clutched in his hands.

The peacekeeper died before he could finish his mission or deliver his message himself. By retrieving and inspecting his bloodstained note, an adventurer can decipher his final instructions and see his dying wish fulfilled.
faq.q: What is the peacekeeper's last request?

faq.answer: Peacekeepers serve as protectors tasked with maintaining order and defending settlements and roads from danger. Falling in the field leaves their duties unfinished and their allies unwarned unless someone recovers their final reports.

sections.body: A Last Request begins with a grim discovery in the field: the lifeless body of a fallen peacekeeper. Slumped in death, the guardian still clutches a bloodstained note that slips free upon inspection. In these turbulent days on Zephras, peacekeepers often pay the ultimate price trying to maintain order, and recovering their dying words is frequently the only way to uncover what befell them.
sections.title: A Grim Discovery

sections.body: The bloodied parchment pried from the peacekeeper's hands contains his final plea or instructions. Whoever ended the guard's life left his duty unfinished, leaving it to whoever finds the body to interpret the clues and see his final mission completed. Reading the note provides the critical direction needed to proceed and answer the fallen sentinel's dying call.
sections.title: The Final Message

summary: A Last Request begins upon discovering the corpse of a fallen peacekeeper in the field. Clutched in the dead guard's hands is a bloodstained note containing vital clues about his final moments. Reading his dying words offers the only way to carry out his unfinished duty and bring closure to his fate.
